stemMd: Two resistors are connected in series to a battery in a steady circuit. Which statement is necessarily true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Their equivalent resistance is smaller than either.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The voltage across each must be equal.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The same current passes through both resistors.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The smaller resistor carries no current.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The larger resistor carries more current.

explanationMd: A series circuit has no branch point between the resistors, so charge conservation requires the same steady current through each. Voltage drops depend on their individual resistances.

distractorRationale.e: A series branch has one common current.
distractorRationale.d: Current passes through the whole series path.
